intro: First Peter is a letter of hope from the apostle Peter, to Christians scattered and suffering for their faith.
Chapters one and two speak of a living hope, and a new identity as God's people. Chapters three to five show how to live well, even when treated unfairly.
Listen for: casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

card.parts: Ch. 1–2: a living hope | Ch. 3–5: living well in hard times
card.key: A living hope (1) · Living stones (2) · Casting all your care (5)

next_say: Peter's second letter, about growing in grace
